##### Project general facts

Marlin 2 is an architectural masterpiece by Reportage Group, one of the largest private developers in the UAE. Inspired by the rhythm of the waves, this stunning residential tower flows with the elegance of the ocean and the dance of sunlight, standing as a tribute to fluidity, movement, and timeless design. Offering an exclusive collection of two, three, and four-bedroom apartments, the development redefines luxury living with a seamless blend of nature's artistry and human innovation. More than just a structure, it is an experience—crafted for those who see beyond the horizon.

Residents enjoy an array of world-class amenities designed to enhance the serene waterfront experience, including a large swimming pool, a kids' swimming pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, kids' play areas, shaded seating areas, and private balconies or terraces. Four large elevators and a service elevator ensure seamless vertical travel. Every moment becomes an exceptional memory in a space where life flows flawlessly and luxury is the keyword.

3. Interiors of Contemporary Art, Natural Light, and Premium Finishes
Every residence at Marlin 2 features expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light and reflections of blue, creating airy spaces where sunlight leads the way. Interiors include fully tiled bathrooms, en-suite bedrooms where applicable, built-in wardrobes, kitchen cabinets and countertops, vanity units and mirrors, double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, and high-speed fiber optic internet connectivity. The modern aesthetics and contemporary design create a magical touch of glamour where every detail is a statement of class.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Reem Island, located around six hundred meters off the north-eastern coast of Abu Dhabi, this exceptional location offers the luxury of city life without its hustle and bustle. With three bridges connecting the island to Downtown Abu Dhabi, the waterfront community's accessible location makes it one of the most popular places to live in the UAE capital. The island is categorized as one of the best communities for living and investment in Abu Dhabi, adopting a "work play live" lifestyle.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. Shams Boutik, Reem Mall, Abu Dhabi Mall, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, Galleria Mall, Al Reem Central Park, Downtown Abu Dhabi, Louvre Abu Dhabi, and Saadiyat Island are all within easy reach. The island is also situated near the financial district on Al Maryah Island, the culture hub of Saadiyat Island, and all major roadways.

For those seeking a residence that embodies wave-inspired elegance, modern convenience, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Al Reem Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of waterfront living, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of the capital's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
